sections.text: Continued to RIH w/ torque tool to 117m

M/u TDS and RIH, engaged to tie-back adapter. Marked pipe. Attempted to back out adapter counter clockwise. Broke at 39knm. Measured distance 1,5in after 5 turns. Suspected broken at connection. M/u back to 1knm. POOH, visually checked every connection. Observed connection above x-over broke.

Cleaned x-over connection and m/u to HWDP without applying pipe dope. All connections m/u to 67knm, saver sub m/u to 50knm. RIH, engaged to tie-back adapter. Marked pipe. Attempted to back out adapter counter clockwise. Broke at Measured distance 1,5in after 5 turns. Suspected at connection. M/u back to 1knm. POOH, visually checked every connection. Observed connection above x-over broke.

Cleaned x-over connection and m/u to HWDP to 74knm without applying pipe dope. All DP connections m/u to 67knm, saver sub m/u to 50knm. RIH, engaged to tie-back adapter. Marked pipe. Attempted to back out adapter counter clockwise. Broke at Observed saver sub connection broke. M/u saver sub again to 50knm and attempted to break. Observed saver sub connection broke.
R/u manual tong and held TBT for use of manual tongs

Trapped 20 KNM in with shaft and applied TDS break. Put tong on and pulled 20 KNM, released brake and pulled with tong to 25k n/m. Applied TDS brake. Pulled up to MAX 30knm with rig tong, observed torq reduced on TDS shaft. Took off rig tong, rotated TDS counter clockwise to make sure free. Made string back up to 2knm. POOH, visually checked all connections. No connections have been observed backed out
Started RIH w/ torque tool
Carried out weekly HSE drill, table top exercise regarding volumetric well control

Continued RIH w/ torque tool. Engaged to tie-back adapter. Marked pipe. Attempted to back out adapter counter clockwise. Applied 25knm in steps before pipe started to rotate. Than rotated free at 2knm. Measured distance 1,5in after 5 turns. POOH. Observed no torque tool/x/over on the drill pipe left in hole
RIH w/ DP from surface to 137 m. M/u TDS and latched on to fish. POOH from to surface. L/d torque tool
P/u left hand tie-back adapter torque tool and m/u to x/o
RIH torque tool on 5,5in left hand DP. From surface to 140. P/u singles from cantilever
Left hand x-over arrived on the rig. Inspected and discovered it was right hand x-over. Evaluated situation. Meanwhile performed hydraulic test on bx4.
P/u 1x more joint of DP and m/u to string. Attempted to break off tie-back adapter using rig tongs on DP. Pulled 28knm. Cathead fully stroked out. No success
Evaluated situation. Meanwhile performed tests on aft iron roughneck
POOH from 140m to surface. L/d torque tool. Clean and clear rig floor
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u drill collars from deck
P/u and RIH 8,25 DC from surface to 90m joints). R/b same in derrick
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u guns
R/u to run guns
P/u and m/u TCP gun BHA from surface to 17m
Performed pre-job meeting to handle guns w/ new crew
Continued to m/u guns BHA to 18m
RIH w/ guns on 5,5in DP to 138m

M/u TDS and positioned guns at 151. 7m, closed uprs and applied 20 bar to IBOP, opened to confirm line up. Up/down weights 72t/68t, flushed ball seat with 222 l/min. Opened uprs, broke out connection and dropped 1 3/8in ball. M/u connection and positioned guns at firing depth 144,5-147,5m shot), closed uprs and lined up through fully open choke

Pumped down ball with 160 l/min, sheared ball seat at 150 bar. Indication of guns firing vibration on surface). Top shot at 144,5m, bottom shot at 147,5m. Continued pumping with 150 l/min until returns, increased to 770 l/min, observed slight gain of 500ltr and then losses of 60m3/hr. Pumped 1,5 times btms up, gas observed and still on losses

Stopped pumping, left choke open and opened uprs, observed increase in flow. Close uprs and closed choke, monitored for pressure on chole. Initially 1 bar, slowly increased to 2. 9 bar then leveled out. Opened choke and slowly bled off pressure to 1 bar, closed choke and monitored for pressure build up, OK, no build up observed

Opened choke and circulateed with uprs closed with 760 l/min, initially observed 60m3/hr losses. After confirmed returns increased flow rate to 890 l/min 2,5 bar, MAX gas of 4. 3 Continued circulating until gas content curve showed downward trend. Total losses since punch 21m3
Stopped pumping and flowchecked through fully open choke, static. Opened uprs and flowchecked on trip tanks, static
Started POOH from 147m
